6fb642e5.text:
Grish-

Your request for some time off has been accepted. I am sending a reserve $R warrior to watch your post while you take time off to spend with your family. Report back in one week!

-Maggran Earthbinder
6fb642e5.title: Maggran's Reserve Letter

9bc8a0b1.text:
Apothecary Lydon,

I hope this letter reaches you swiftly and its bearer in good condition.  A need has arisen in distant Kalimdor that I believe will require your skills.

I will be brief.

A crisis develops in the Stonetalon Mountains, not far from our $R allies' homeland of Mulgore.  The goblin-run Venture company is mining and lumbering fiercely in those moutains, enraging the mountain spirits.
9bc8a0b1.title: Zamah's Note

1058-progress.name: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
1058-progress.text:
Look at our poor little elf friends. All caged up with no forest to frolic in!

Now were you able to find me some sap? How about the whiskers from the twilight runners? Don't suppose you have that fey dragon scale on you?

And eyes! I'll need so many eyes! You just can't mix up a fierce forest magic brew without a good helping of eyes!
1058-progress.title: Jin'Zil's Forest Magic

1060-progress.name: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
1060-progress.text: You seem a shady character. You have something for me to see?
1060-progress.title: Letter to Jin'Zil

1093-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
1093-progress.title: Super Reaper 6000

1096-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-progress.text: Sputtervalve will want some sort of proof that Gerenzo's dead. I think his mechanical arm will probably do.
1096-progress.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1131-accept.name: Melor Stonehoof
1131-accept.text:
At times we hunt for food.  At times we hunt for honor.  And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.

But the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things.  $N is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.

The hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens.  He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.

Find Steelsnap, $N.  Find him, and defeat him.
1131-accept.title: Steelsnap

3369-complete.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-complete.text:
Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...

<Hamuul peers into the shard>

Oh... I didn't... Well.

$N, thank you for delivering this to me. $N isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that you should not concern yourself with.

Let's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...

Perhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
3369-complete.title: In Nightmares

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

442-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
442-progress.text: The Scourge cannot be allowed to remain in Silverpine, $N.  Come back to me when you have proof of Thule's death.
442-progress.title: Assault on Fenris Isle

460-complete.name: Shallow Grave
460-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  I had feared the Gnolls destroyed my body.  $N is good to know they did not.
460-complete.title: Resting in Pieces

461-accept.name: Shallow Grave
461-accept.text:
I know of a hidden niche within the keep that holds an item dear to Thule, and his old colleagues.  $N also holds something you might find useful.  Take me there!

The alcove is in the southwestern tower of the keep, behind a dusty shelf.

Take my body, but leave my boots.  They never fit me anyway...
461-accept.title: The Hidden Niche

461-progress.name: Dusty Shelf
461-progress.text: This is the spot!  Bring me closer...
461-progress.title: The Hidden Niche

4921-progress.name: Mankrik
4921-progress.text: Have you found any sign of her at all? The pain in my chest tells me that the worst has happened, but I have hope you will find her safe and sound.
4921-progress.title: Lost in Battle

498-complete.name: Krusk
498-complete.text:
So the humans thought to turn our warriors into slaves, did they? We'll show them!

$N would seem that they have taken Gol'dir, our leader, to another location. We must find him and rescue him. But we currently have no clue where he is...

When we have a lead, I will be sure to tell you, $N.
498-complete.title: The Rescue

5046-progress.name: Mangletooth
5046-progress.text:
All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection.
5046-progress.title: Razorhide

5052-progress.name: Mangletooth
5052-progress.text:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> $N will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>
5052-progress.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

5881-progress.name: Grish Longrunner
5881-progress.text: You have news from Maggran Earthbinder?
5881-progress.title: Calling in the Reserves

6283-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6283-progress.text:
Bloodfury Ripper is a nasty creature! You will have success finding her along the western hill line in the Charred Vale.

The bloodfuries will be helpless with out... surely we can vanquish them forever!
6283-progress.title: Bloodfury Bloodline

6284-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-progress.text: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.
6284-progress.title: Arachnophobia

6301-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-progress.text: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, $c?
6301-progress.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6381-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-progress.text:
These seeds you plant are strong, resisting corruption, and making a foothold for other life. They will grow and grow, first preventing corruption and healing the scarred land, and then one day, restoring Stonetalon to a lush forest, once again.

Have you planted all of the Gaea seeds?
6381-progress.title: New Life

6393-progress.name: Tsunaman
6393-progress.text: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?
6393-progress.title: Elemental War

6421-progress.name: Mor'rogal
6421-progress.text: What news have you discovered from Boulderslide Ravine? I recall some legend that deals with Resonite... I just cannot place my hoof on it. Perhaps knowing what lies at the bottom of the cave will illuminate their devious intentions.
6421-progress.title: Boulderslide Ravine

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

843-progress.name: Gann Stonespire
843-progress.text: Many innocent tauren lost their lives or were forced off their ancestral birthplace when the dwarves of Bael Modan arrived. My land must be reclaimed!
843-progress.title: Gann's Reclamation

846-accept.name: Gann Stonespire
846-accept.text:
$N is clear the prospector depended on explosives and those noisy vehicles to rip the ground apart. We can expect a new foreman to take over soon.

I want to give the dwarves a taste of their own medicine. According to these plans if we combine nitroglycerin with wood pulp and sodium nitrate we can create an explosive charge. The rifleman, soldiers and officers in the Keep are known to have the supplies.

Collect these items and bring them to me. I will fashion a charge that the dwarves won't forget!
846-accept.title: Revenge of Gann

846-progress.name: Gann Stonespire
846-progress.text:
I see you are back, $N.

While Khazgorm's death might delay the digging in my ancestral lands some, it will by no means bring a total end to the destruction.

The Keep at Bael Modan is an increasing military threat. Built to defend the dig site, it is now poised for offensive force as well.

If you have the ingredients I requested, I can fashion a charge that will make the hasty dwarves reconsider their actions here in the Barrens.
846-progress.title: Revenge of Gann

857-progress.name: Feegly the Exiled
857-progress.text: Where is the Tear of the Moons? I need it now! Need I say!
857-progress.title: The Tear of the Moons

86576-progress.name: Mor'rogal
86576-progress.text: I have important matters to consider, $c. Be quick.
86576-progress.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

868-progress.name: Korran
868-progress.text: Be careful with the eggs you find, $N. If they break, they be no good to me.
868-progress.title: Egg Hunt

869-accept.name: Gazrog
869-accept.text:
Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen from our guard tower.  $N was meant as payroll to the Crossroads' guards, and we want that silver back.

The strange thing is... we caught one of the thieves on the night of the theft.  And... it was a raptor!  Unbelievable!

I don't know what raptors would want with silver.  But I don't care -- I want the raptors dead so they won't steal from us again!

Hunt raptors in the Barrens.  Collect for me their heads!
869-accept.title: Raptor Thieves

878-accept.name: Mangletooth
878-accept.text:
You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> $N gives us strength in all things... especially war.

If you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.
878-accept.title: Tribes at War

879-progress.name: Mangletooth
879-progress.text:
How goes your hunt, $r? <snort>

Thork thinks he knows the truth about who leads the raids against his people, <snort> but he shall learn how wrong he is if you are successful.

My death is inescapable, but you have caused great pain to my enemies, so Mangletooth regrets nothing. <snort>
879-progress.title: Betrayal from Within

889-progress.name: Mangletooth
889-progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

$N will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
889-progress.title: Spirit of the Wind

891-progress.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-progress.text: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
891-progress.title: The Guns of Northwatch

893-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-progress.text:
I, too, have doubts that the pathetic quilboars could attain any level of skill in the area of smithing, but I do as the Warchief commands, and I shall learn what I can about the Razormane tribe.

I have had more menial tasks, and I do so willingly if it aids the orc people.
893-progress.title: Weapons of Choice

899-progress.name: Mankrik
899-progress.text: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.
899-progress.title: Consumed by Hatred

95774-progress.name: Mankrik
95774-progress.text: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.
95774-progress.title: Her Name Is Olgra

95883-complete.name: Unknown
95883-complete.text:
<The tortured soul lets out a foul energy in the presence of the offering stone.

$N appears you are closer to fulfilling the ritual.>
95883-complete.title: The Tortured Soul

95885-complete.name: Unknown
95885-complete.text:
<The offering stone is inert now. $N appears your ritual drained it of power. To what end, you do not know, but it is over now.

The rough stone cracks and crumbles, now devoid of purpose.

Something glitters from within the remnants...>
95885-complete.title: The Offering of Blood

97003-accept.name: Gur'ak
97003-accept.text:
You there, $c. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". $N's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, $c.
97003-accept.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97003-progress.name: Gur'ak
97003-progress.text:
$N took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.

If these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the quilboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
97003-progress.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97288-accept.name: Unknown
97288-accept.text:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. $N seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>
97288-accept.title: Unending Torment

97289-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97289-accept.text:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. $N belonged to a Grand Marshal of the Alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
97289-accept.title: Unending Torment

97291-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97291-progress.text: $N will be ever so lovely to have our lost sheep returned to the fold, don't you think?
97291-progress.title: Unending Torment

97538-progress.name: Tah Winterhoof
97538-progress.text:
You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?

We $r have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.
97538-progress.title: Pigments for Paints
